chapters.title: A Symmetry Inside the Public Key
chapters.blurb: A second Galois involution turns the hidden secret cocycle into a shortest vector satisfying public linear conditions in a rank-n lattice.

chapters.title: The Near-Hypercube
chapters.blurb: A secret isometry reveals the cocycle lattice as near-hypercubic, with its decisive shortest vectors living in a block of dimension n/2+1.

chapters.title: Half-Dimension Key Recovery
chapters.blurb: A congruence filter, lattice descent, gate-count reductions, and an end-to-end HAWK-256 implementation complete the key-recovery path and define its scope.
